nodes.label: Curation Core

nodes.rationale: Deterministic template-based synthesis of the day's news to provide original content.

nodes.label: Deduplication Engine
nodes.rationale: Tiered matcher using entities, time windows, and headline similarity to cluster stories.

nodes.label: Cloudflare R2
nodes.rationale: Storage for raw feeds, pre-rendered story HTML, and media variants.

nodes.label: Cloudflare Workers
nodes.rationale: Used for ingest (cron) and serving the story tier from R2.

nodes.label: fast-xml-parser
nodes.rationale: Pure JS parser chosen for speed and compatibility with both Node (CI) and Workers.

nodes.label: Canonical Rules
nodes.rationale: Self-referential canonicals only to prevent organic traffic loss to original publishers.

nodes.label: Delivery Model
nodes.rationale: Cloudflare Workers Static Assets for static tier, R2 for story tier, and CI for transformation to bypass 10ms CPU and 20k file limits.

nodes.label: Google News Compliance
nodes.rationale: Critical constraint to avoid 'scaled content abuse' penalties; requires original value layer.

nodes.label: Ingest Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Fetch-only Worker captures raw bytes to R2; CI handles parsing and deduplication to stay within Free-tier CPU limits.

nodes.label: The Meridian
nodes.rationale: Automatically-curated daily news portal for seven countries, designed to survive Google's scaled content abuse policies.

nodes.label: Cloudflare Workers AI
nodes.rationale: Used for embeddings (dedup), text generation (digests), and section classification.

nodes.label: Ingest Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Fetches publisher RSS feeds and persists raw snapshots to R2.

nodes.label: Cloudflare D1
nodes.rationale: System of record for normalized stories and metadata.

nodes.label: Cloudflare R2
nodes.rationale: Storage for raw feed snapshots, pre-rendered story HTML, and media variants.

nodes.label: Cloudflare Workers
nodes.rationale: Primary compute platform; chosen for zero-cost constraint and cron triggers.

nodes.label: Astro Shell
nodes.rationale: Static-first framework used for the frontend; output is pre-rendered HTML.

nodes.label: Publication Surface
nodes.rationale: The frontend layer comprising edition pages, section pages, and story permalinks.

nodes.label: SEO Strategy
nodes.rationale: Focuses on self-referential canonicals, news sitemaps, and locale path prefixes.

nodes.label: Cloudflare D1
nodes.rationale: System of record for stories and clusters.

nodes.label: D1 Data Model
nodes.rationale: Single database topology chosen over sharding to support cross-edition queries like cross-country flagging.

nodes.label: Astro 7.4.1
nodes.rationale: Chosen for zero-JS default and incremental build support; adapter-less deployment to Workers Static Assets.

nodes.label: Tailwind CSS 4.3.3
nodes.rationale: v4 used for CSS-first theme configuration fitting broadsheet design tokens.
